scenes.title: The mill confrontation
scenes.summary: C01 holds off C05 while C02 broadcasts the evidence and defeats C06's interference. Public attention, C01's restraint and arriving police end C04 and C06's control.
scenes.purpose: Resolve the exposure through physical resistance, C02's initiative and public witness rather than violence alone.

people.wants: Protect C02 and prevent the evidence from being reclaimed.
Keep the evidence audible and stop its suppression.
Recover the phone and money and regain control.

blocks.intent: Stage the opposing forces around C01.
blocks.delivery_hint: Use arriving headlights to reduce C01 to an outline.

events.change: The three opponents arrive; backlighting isolates C01.

blocks.intent: Establish the assets C04 wants reclaimed.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the demand focused on the contested evidence and funds.

events.change: C04 seeks surrender of both contested assets.

blocks.speaker: C04
blocks.intent: Deny C01 the right to choose.

events.change: C04 invokes hierarchy to undermine C01's resistance.

blocks.speaker: C01
blocks.intent: Claim responsibility for his own course.
Make resistance depend on weight, terrain and limited space.
blocks.delivery_hint: Preserve a single handheld take with readable short-range contact.

events.change: C05 attacks and C01 fights amid stored sacks, metal and slippery flooring.

blocks.intent: Give C02 the decisive disclosure action.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make activation clear without inventing a new phone location.

events.change: C02 enables the prepared public playback.

blocks.intent: Expose both recorded participants through public playback.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the two recorded voices distinguishable across the village soundscape.

events.change: The recorded voices of C04 and C06 become publicly audible.

blocks.intent: Make C02 actively defeat the attempted suppression.
blocks.delivery_hint: Clarify the interruption and restoration through the power controls and sound.

events.change: C06 interferes with the supply; C02 obstructs him and restores it.

blocks.speaker: C02
blocks.intent: Reject the use of official status to silence the truth.

events.change: C02 directly challenges C06's claimed authority.

blocks.intent: Resolve the threat through public pressure, disarmament and restraint.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the headlight advantage and disarming kick clear; do not turn the refusal to kill into an execution attempt.

events.change: A village crowd gathers around the building.
C04 threatens C02 with a firearm but loses vision in the headlights.
C01 kicks the firearm out of play and spares C04.
Arriving officers take C04 and C06 into custody.
